pages.title: Connections
pages.intent: A composed connection list with a useful adjacent inspector.

before.label: Original edit dialog · overview visible behind

gaps: The header-aligned inspector, selected row, compact toolbar and left-pane private-network callout now follow the final vision at all three desktop sizes.

Actual inventory contains one connection and two approved tools; the reference's extra rows and tool counts were not fabricated. Recorded historical success is separate from a current connectivity check.

The production inspector retains tabs and secondary metadata/runtime disclosures. Its inner Test status and Tool access sections sit slightly lower than the illustration; primary actions and tool card remain visible at the reference height.

pages.title: Add connection
pages.intent: One polished setup surface for URL, pasted configuration and credentials.

after.label: Previous implementation · Paste config · parsed example; secret unset
Previous implementation · Server URL · empty form

gaps: The approximately 912px dialog now has the reference's method strip, format tabs, numbered editor, parsed feedback, horizontal authentication fields, optional name and fixed action footer.
The safe example uses a DOCS_TOKEN reference with an empty secret draft. Review stays disabled until required data is present; no connection was inspected or saved for these captures.

The actual credential destination is an installation-local development file and is described truthfully. URL, approved-connector and edit states retain their required controls; lower controls remain reachable at 1440×900.

pages.title: Global connectors
pages.intent: An installation-level library with deliberate catalogue and import layouts.

before.label: Previously: connector selection inside a Brain wizard

pages.beforeNote: There was no installation-level Connectors page. This original screenshot shows where approved connectors were selected before.
gaps: The compact card grid, 80px icon tile, large import illustration, filled import action and numbered Import/Review/Approve rail now match the final catalogue composition.
There is one real approved definition, with actual Approved/Disabled/All filters. The reference's six fictional definitions and Pending review count were not inserted.

The global library retains the last actually selected authorized Brain navigation. Catalogue authority remains installation-scoped; the selected Brain is neither guessed nor an additional global permission.

pages.title: Privacy
pages.intent: Compact, stable inline settings with the key sections visible together.

before.label: Original retention edit state · scrolled page

after.label: Previous implementation · Retention edit · page auto-scrolled to editor
Previous implementation · Read view · top of page

gaps: Retention now leads the page; view and edit keep the same number/unit rows. The compact warning and Save/Cancel line, sage switches and section glyphs follow the approved image.

All four evidence retention classes and separate capture/storage flags remain visible in compact rows. The generated image simplifies these real policies; they have not been merged or removed to copy its sample content.
At 1586×992 the edited Capture, Evidence and Repository cards all fit. At 1440×900 lower sections are reached by ordinary page scrolling, with no horizontal clipping.

pages.title: AI permissions
pages.intent: A clear permission policy with calm coverage and model information beside it.
gaps: Provider and automatic-memory strips, five purpose rows, two-column allowed-content checks and separate Coverage/Models/More options cards now closely follow the final vision.
The captures use actual installed model names and current index counts rather than the illustration's sample numbers. Configured provider/model badges are not claims of a successful provider call.
Diagnostics stay closed on the main page and open explicitly. At 1586×992 all three rail cards fit; the full More options controls remain reachable at 1440×900.

pages.title: Agents
pages.intent: A legible roster and two focused companion cards, with useful visual weight.

before.label: Original attached Agents screenshot · content only

after.label: Previous implementation · Observed roster + setup + memory check

gaps: The weighted owner/roster typography, host glyphs, rounded credential pills, concise observed dates and filled Connect agent action now follow the final image.
The setup card uses the supported Recollect connect-skill prompt for the selected Brain, rather than the image's illustrative CLI shorthand. Agent names and observed dates come from actual inventory.

The compact host strip, setup controls, full-width memory-check copy button and private-context link remain visible. Utility card bottoms now closely align with the reference, and lower controls are reachable at the shorter desktop height.
